decisions.state_note: o000: Window near x153–217,y158–222 is mostly white; small dark fragment at its upper-left corner, insufficient to identify a digit.

o001: Window near x153–217,y126–190 shows a dark fragment along its upper-left edge, with a sloping right contour reaching about (153,163); remaining visible area is white. No detector instances; digit remains unclear.

o002: Window x121–185,y126–190 shows a thick diagonal dark band rising right, from the left edge near y173 toward the top near x167; white lies on both sides. Band is cropped at top and left, so endpoints are unknown.
o003: Window x121–185,y94–158 shows a thick dark diagonal rising right, continuing through bottom-left and top-right crop edges. White visible on both sides; no true endpoint or junction established.

o004: Window x121–185,y62–126 shows dark material along the right edge with an irregular left contour near x158–172, and a small dark fragment at the upper-left edge. White separates them locally; connections outside the crop remain unknown. No detector instances.

o005: Window x121–185,y30–94 shows a thick dark curved band across the upper area bending down the right side, with a white recess below near x132–157,y58–82. Dark portions reach crop edges; no closure established. Detector reports no instances.

o006: Window x89–153,y30–94 shows a dark upper band with white below and a diagonal dark band rising right through roughly (113,76), consistent with detector. Bands meet near the upper-right portion; lower continuation is cropped. Digit remains uncertain.

o007: Window x89–153,y62–126 shows a thick dark band rising right from the left edge near y116 toward x120 at the top, with white on both sides; detector agrees. Its continuation below remains unknown.

o008: Window x89–153,y94–158 shows dark fragments at upper-left and lower-right, separated by broad white space. Both fragments meet crop edges; no endpoints or closure visible. Detector has no instances.
o009: Window x89–153,y126–190 shows a thick dark band rising right from near (100,180) to the right edge near y140, with white on both sides; detector agrees. Lower-left continuation remains cropped.

o010: Window x57–121,y126–190 shows a thick dark bend down the left side and toward the lower right, bordering a white recess above-right. Dark material reaches several crop edges; closure and endpoints remain unknown. No detector instances. A slanted loop is a hypothesis.

o011: Window x57–121,y94–158 shows a thick dark band rising right from near (62,146) toward (108,94), with white on both sides; detector agrees. Lower continuation crosses the crop. A slanted 0 is a hypothesis; upper-left connection remains unobserved.

o012: Window x57–121,y62–126 shows a small downward rounded dark tip near (75,80), surrounded by white below, and a separate visible diagonal band rising right across the lower-right area. Detector agrees with both features. Their connection outside this crop is unknown; the tip complicates the earlier 0 hypothesis.

o013: Window x57–121,y30–94 shows a curved dark stroke rising right from a rounded downward tip near (75,80) toward the upper-right crop edge; white lies below-left. Detector supports the diagonal and true rounded tip. Connection to the other strokes remains uncertain.

o014: Window x57–121,y62–126 again shows rounded downward tip near (75,80) and a separate visible diagonal dark band rising right through the lower-right portion; detector supports both. A 2 with a curved upper start is a hypothesis; lower stroke termination remains unresolved.

o015: Window x57–121,y94–158 shows a dark band rising right, bending toward vertical near the lower-left crop edge; white on both sides. Detector supports the diagonal. Lower termination remains unknown; 2 remains a hypothesis.

o016: Window x57–121,y126–190 shows a dark stroke bending from an upper arm into a rightward lower arm around a white recess near (94,150). Lower continuation is cropped; detector reports no instances. Need the lower contour to distinguish the 2 hypothesis.

o017: Window x57–121,y158–222 shows a dark lower band with a nearly horizontal lower contour around y193 and white below; a white recess enters from the top near x81–105. Detector supports a horizontal segment near (92,180). Rightward continuation is cropped.

o018: Window x89–153,y158–222 shows a dark band rising right, with its lower contour rising from about (89,194) to (153,166) and white below. No detector instances. Together with the upper curved start, central diagonal, and lower bend recorded earlier, this supports digit 2.
